{"chunk_id":"R5-180675-001","collection":"ran5_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["Samsung"],"tdocNumber":"R5-180675","title":"5G work planning RAN5#2-5G-NR Adhoc and RAN5#79"},"point_id":"13172403372814083979"}
wner and Task Supervisor. - The Task Owner is responsible to do the job specified by the task. - The Task Supervisor is responsible to ensure that this happens. - If a task is not completed by the target date it is the responsibility of the Task Supervisor to assess the reasons and find solution of the problems which have led to the delay. This solution may include finding new Task Owner or the Task Supervisor doing the job by themselves. There are still a large number of tasks in every WP e.g. Test Cases or Sections or Annexes to be drafted which do not have assigned Owners (i.e. Companies responsible for their drafting). This needs to change. - In the plan for each spec an individual task has been assigned to this matter. The sub Rapporteurs are responsible for the completion of this task. In order this to be achieved successfully - on one side, Companies shall come up and get responsibilities, it seems that many 5G WI Supporting companies are not doing much - if they do not then, the question is how they see their role as supporting companies; . from another side, the WP Rapporteurs should not rely on sending e-mails to everyone and waiting for responses rather they shall be more proactive and approach directly the supporting companies. No sufficient time to work on the officially published core specs. Most likely they be available only towards the end of March. Therefore - Contributing companies should look whenever possible into agreed CRs and draft specs.

Title: Cleanup for TS 38.521-3 spurious emission for UE co-existence table for Rel-15 Reason for change: For several bands in UE co-existence tables harmonic exceptions are missed. This CR introduces harmonic exceptions for some bands. Spec 38.101-3 Rel-15 Table 6.5B.3.3.2-1 changed. This CR aligns 38.521-3 with 38.101-3 spec. Summary of change: This CR makes correction for TS 38.521-3 Table 6.5B.3.3.2.3-1. DC_2_n5: Added harmonic exception for bands 53 as they can be affected by second and third harmonic DC_26_n79: Added harmonic exception for band 41 as it can be affected by thrid harmonic. Also added harmonic exception for fifth frequency range as it can be affected by thrid harmonic. DC_66_n71: Added harmonic exception for bands 7and 22 as they can be affected by second and fourth harmonic Editorial change in the table NOTE Consequences if not approved: UE may fail the co-existence compliance tests as harmonic exceptions are missing for several bands and CA Clauses affected: 6.5B.3.3.2

Title: Correction of spurious emission minimum conformance requirements for UE co-ex to align with RAN4 specs Reason for change: There are some misalignments in the minimum conformance requirement tables in the RAN5 spec, compared to the RAN4 spec TS38.101-1. Summary of change: In Table 6.5.3.2.3-1 (Rel-15), modify the protected bands for n25 and n40. In Table 6.5.3.2.3-3 (Rel-17), modify the protected bands for n74. Consequences if not approved: The misalignments will remain in the RAN5 spec. Clauses affected: 6.5.3.2.3

{"chunk_id":"R5-176008-061","collection":"ran5_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":[],"tdocNumber":"R5-176008","title":"Latest RAN Plenary draft Report"},"point_id":"2158482387210782001"}
ussion: Proposal 1: create a new RAN1-led technical specification to specify channel access mechanisms for unlicensed and shared spectrum, taking the Rel-13/14/15 contents of section 15 of 36.213. Consider the 37 spec series. Proposal 2: create new RAN4 specifications for including the unlicensed band definition, i.e. band 46, and all the requirements related to LBT mechanism for both BS and UE, including channel access procedures, RRM for frame structure 3, and demodulation tests for LAA/eLAA. Consider the 37 spec series. RAN chair: changes REL-13 onwards or REL-15 onwards? Huawei: REL-15 onwards RAN chair: may give problems with mirror CRs Samsung: impact on NR specs? Huawei: that's why we suggest 37 series specs CableLabs: band 49 is under discussion, is the time right to do this now? Ericsson: 37 series includes MSR specs which we forgot for IMT-2020 submission RAN chair: this is not the reason why 37 series is proposed here Ericsson: 36.300 also has also LAA aspects RAN chair: which WGs? Huawei: RAN1 and RAN4 RAN chair: so we will come back at RAN #78 how to do this in detail MCC: new WID for this? Huawei: no, we will revise WID for LTE_unlic and do the changes under this WI conclusion: revised WID for LTE_unlic will be provided to RAN #78 how to change REL-15 specs (no CRs for this to RAN #78) and which new REL-15 37 series specs will be introduced for this Decision: The document was noted. rses one of the following proposals list below Proposal 2.1: To define version controlled Rel-16 NR test specs as per RAN4s DRAFT Rel-16 core specs-- both Rel-15 and Rel-16 NR test specs will be maintained simultaneously. Pros: To fulfill the requirements from industry to the greatest extent. Cons: RAN5 never maintain any version controlled RAN5 specs as per the DRAFT core spec and RAN5 does NOT have different spec versions for different releases, all core spec release contents go into the same test spec, and the test spec version corresponds to the latest core spec version that test spec is derived from. Proposal 2.3: Only to prepare and endorse Rel-16 CRs basing on Rel-15 test specs during the 2 RAN5 meetings of RAN5#4 Ad-hoc@April and RAN5#83@May. No draft Rel-16 test specs in RAN5. All the RAN5 agreed Rel-16 CRs will be submitted to RP#84@June together with RAN4 Rel-16 CRs for approval. The corresponding RAN5 test specs will be raised from Rel-15 to Rel-16 (as RAN5 is only maintaining one version in the traditional practice). MCC need to implement at first all RAN #84 approved Rel-15 CRs into 15.x.x, then MCC will take this 15.x.x version and implement all Rel-16 CRs to make a 16.x.x. Proposal 2.4: To define Rel-16 TR(s) to capture all the required Rel-16 content (delta vs Rel-15 RAN5 TSs) until the RAN4 Rel-16 TSs have been approved. Proposal 3: RAN5#5 5G-NR Adhoc@April and RAN5#83@May meetings shall only handle CRs covering Rel-16 NR CA/DC Band Combinations that have 100% core part completed by RAN4#90@Feb. RAN5 should have visibility to the status of individual Rel-16 NR CA/DC band combinations after RAN4#90@Feb. through the WI Status Reports submitted to RP#83@March. Discussion: Decision: The document was revised to R5-190618. R5-190618 Discussion on defining a New WI for Rel-16 NR CA/DC band combinations Type: discussion For: Endorsement Source: CMCC, China Telecom, China Unicom, AT&T, T-Mobile USA, Sprint, Verizon, NTT DOCOMO, Orange, Dish, CAICT, Huawei, Hisilicon, MediaTek, Spreadtrum, Keysight, Anritsu, R&S, CATT, StarPoint, ZTE, vivo, SRTC, Tejet, Lenovo (Replaces R5-190135) Decision: The document was noted. R5-190220 5GS RF 38.101-x workplans vs NR band and CA/DC configuration workplan Type: discussion For: Information Source: Ericsson Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to highlight the workplan responsibilities for NR bands and CA/DC configurations between the RF, RRM and protocol test case work plans and the work plan on NR bands and CA and DC configurations.
